tools.name: merge_duplicate_contacts
tools.description: Merges a duplicate contact into a primary contact by copying over missing fields and reassigning its deals, then permanently deletes the duplicate contact record.

params.name: primary_id
params.description: ID of the contact to keep

params.name: duplicate_id
params.description: ID of the contact to merge and delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "crm.db"


def _fill_missing_fields(conn, primary_id, duplicate_id):
    primary = conn.execute("SELECT email, phone, company FROM contacts WHERE id = ?", (primary_id,)).fetchone()
    dup = conn.execute("SELECT email, phone, company FROM contacts WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,)).fetchone()
    merged = [p or d for p, d in zip(primary, dup)]
    conn.execute("UPDATE contacts SET email = ?, phone = ?, company = ? WHERE id = ?", (*merged, primary_id))


@function_tool
def merge_duplicate_contacts(primary_id: int, duplicate_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        _fill_missing_fields(conn, primary_id, duplicate_id)
        conn.execute("UPDATE deals SET contact_id = ? WHERE contact_id = ?", (primary_id, duplicate_id))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM contacts WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,))
    conn.close()
    return f"Merged contact {duplicate_id} into {primary_id}"

tools.name: email_deal_proposal
tools.description: Sends a proposal email to a contact with the deal name and quoted amount. The message is delivered to the contact's email address through the company SMTP server.
tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("crm")


def _build_message(to_email, contact_name, deal_name, amount):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = os.environ["SALES_FROM_ADDRESS"]
    msg["To"] = to_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Proposal: {deal_name}"
    body = (
        f"Hello {contact_name},\n\n"
        f"Thank you for your interest. Our proposal for {deal_name} "
        f"is ${amount:,.2f}.\n\n"
        "Please reply with any questions.\n\nBest regards,\nSales Team"
    )
    msg.set_content(body)
    return msg


@mcp.tool()
def email_deal_proposal(to_email: str, contact_name: str, deal_name: str, amount: float) -> str:
    msg = _build_message(to_email, contact_name, deal_name, amount)
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ["SMTP_HOST"], int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 587))) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        server.send_message(msg)
    return f"Proposal for {deal_name} sent to {to_email}"

tools.name: move_deals_to_pipeline_stage
tools.description: Moves the given deals into another pipeline and stage, and records the move in the deal stage history. Deals that cannot be found are reported as skipped.

params.name: deal_ids
params.description: IDs of the deals to move

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "crm.db"


@dataclass
class MoveResult:
    target_pipeline: str
    target_stage: str
    moved: list = field(default_factory=list)
    skipped: list = field(default_factory=list)


@function_tool
def move_deals_to_pipeline_stage(deal_ids: list[int], target_pipeline: str, target_stage: str) -> MoveResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    result = MoveResult(target_pipeline, target_stage)
    stage = conn.execute(
        "SELECT s.id FROM stages s JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = s.pipeline_id "
        "WHERE p.name = ? AND s.name = ?",
        (target_pipeline, target_stage),
    ).fetchone()
    if stage is None:
        conn.close()
        raise ValueError(f"Stage {target_stage} not found in pipeline {target_pipeline}")
    stage_id = stage[0]
    with conn:
        for deal_id in deal_ids:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT stage_id FROM deals WHERE id = ?", (deal_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                result.skipped.append(deal_id)
                continue
            if row[0] == stage_id:
                result.skipped.append(deal_id)
                continue
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE deals SET stage_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (stage_id, deal_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO deal_stage_history (deal_id, from_stage_id, to_stage_id, moved_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))",
                (deal_id, row[0], stage_id),
            )
            result.moved.append(deal_id)
    conn.close()
    return result
